content.text:
* Level-shifted NMOS folded-cascode plus common-source output
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* DC input division 0.5; capacitive lead reduces input-referred noise
RP VINP GP 750k
RBP GP VDD 750k
RN VINN GN 750k
RBN GN VDD 750k
CP VINP GP 2.5p
CBP GP VDD 0.5p
CN VINN GN 2.5p
CBN GN VDD 0.5p
* Bias reference and P mirror
XREF IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XBC PB IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XPB PB PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
* Folded common-gate bias with resistor headroom offset
XCC PC IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XCD PC PC PS VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
RCS VDD PS 20k
* Input differential pair
XTAIL T IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=80 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XIP DP GP T VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=8
XIN DN GN T VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.15 nf=1 m=8
* Folded branches and single-ended conversion
XUP DP PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=6
XUN DN PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=6
XFP B PC DP VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=3
XFN A PC DN VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=3
XNL A A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 nf=1 m=1
XNR B A VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=2 nf=1 m=1
* Output amplifier
XON VOUT B VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=2
XOP VOUT PB VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=0.5 nf=1 m=14
RZ B CZ 2000
CC CZ VOUT 3.99p
.ends DUT
